scripts.dev: npm run build -w @dashboard/schemas && concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @dashboard/web" "npm run dev -w @dashboard/api"
scripts.dev:https: npm run setup:tls && npm run build -w @dashboard/schemas && concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:https -w @dashboard/web" "npm run dev:https -w @dashboard/api"
scripts.dev:debug: npm run build -w @dashboard/schemas && concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @dashboard/web" "npm run dev:debug -w @dashboard/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @dashboard/schemas && npm run build -w @dashboard/api && npm run build -w @dashboard/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @dashboard/schemas && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.semgrep: if command -v semgrep >/dev/null 2>&1; then semgrep scan --config .semgrep.yml; else docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/src:ro" -w /src semgrep/semgrep semgrep scan --config .semgrep.yml; fi
